questions.targetConstruct: Use reading to resolve “Read: 'You are invited to a birthday party on Saturday at 7 PM. Please bring a small gift. RSVP by Thursday.' What should you do by Thursday?” in the context “Invitation”.
questions.cefrRationale: A2 text task: the learner handles “Invitation” and identifies “Reply to the invitation” using the stated reading cue.
questions.ambiguityNotes: Only “Reply to the invitation” satisfies the stated context and target; the distractors conflict with the prompt or this rule: 'RSVP' means 'please reply' in French ('Répondez s'il vous plaît').
